news_cards.title: Bihar me Steel Hub banane ke liye 51600 karod rupe ka nivesh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU sign kiya hai, jiske tahat Bihar me steel hub banaya jayega
Is nivesh se Bihar me 51600 karod rupe ka nivesh hoga, jisse steel, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko bhi badhava milega
Bihar sarkar ka uddeshya hai ki Bihar ko steel hub banakar desh me steel utpadan me agreshar sthan prapt kiya jaye

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne JP Ganga Path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena ka nishchay kiya hai, jiske liye samagr vikas karyon me tezi layi jayegi
Is pariyojna ke tahat 65 kilometer Ganga channel viksit kiya jayega, jisse Bihar me jal parivahan ko badhava milega
Bihar sarkar ka uddeshya hai ki Ganga Path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena se Bihar me parivahan aur vikas ko badhava mile

news_cards.title: Nasariganj-Panapur nishulk stimer ferry service ka shubharambh
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Nasariganj-Panapur nishulk stimer ferry service ka shubharambh kiya hai, jisse awagaman aur aarthik gatividhiyon ko badhava milega
Is service ke tahat logon ko nishulk stimer ferry ki suvidha pradan ki jayegi, jisse unki yatra ko aasan banaya jayega
Bihar sarkar ka uddeshya hai ki is service se Bihar me parivahan aur vikas ko badhava mile

news_cards.title: Bihar me nasha mukt yuvao ki bhoomika
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne nasha mukt yuvao ki bhoomika ko mahatvapoorn mana hai, jisse viksit Bihar ke nirmaan me unki bhoomika ko badhava diya jayega
Bihar sarkar ne nasha mukt abhiyan me vyaapak janbhagidari ke liye Brahmakumari ke saath MoU kiya hai, jisse nasha mukt yuvao ki bhoomika ko badhava mile
Bihar sarkar ka uddeshya hai ki nasha mukt yuvao ki bhoomika se viksit Bihar ke nirmaan me sahayak kiya jaye
